title: A NEW CODEX GUN IS ONE FEED LINE, NOT TWO CALLOUTS
why: The critic on the raid hud (screen 36): a codex entry showed top centre and again bottom left, the same words twice. say() writes every line into the feed and also into the top lane. The codex note now goes to the feed only, so it reads once, in the left list.
now: A gun you find for the first time is noted once in the left feed, no longer twice on screen.
